source_text: Critics of these rights-based arguments contend that intactivist rhetoric over-relies on anecdotal reports of psychological trauma and body image dissatisfaction, with empirical data from longitudinal studies showing no evidence of widespread mental health harm attributable to neonatal circumcision.
